title: Inverse binary function conversion
statement: For every $n$ and every function $f$ from the binary cube $\mathbb F_2^n$ to the sign set $\{-1,1\}$, converting $f$ to a function on the sign cube and then back to the binary cube recovers $f$ exactly.
